broker_generic_csv.name: Generic CSV
broker_generic_csv.description: Import transactions from a generic CSV file. Auto-detects columns based on header names. Supports various date and number formats.

description.date_order: How the dates in a generic CSV are written: the order of day, month and year, with a four-digit or a two-digit year (yy: 00–68 are 2000–2068, 69–99 are 1969–1999). With dd/mm/yyyy and mm/dd/yyyy a date that cannot be read the chosen way is read the other way (25/12/2025 is always 25 December); a date with a four-digit year still reads in the two-digit-year formats.
